mode.title: What to search
mode.description: 'open' = tenders currently receiving proposals (best for sales teams). 'published' = tenders published between the dates below.
enumTitles: Published in a date range / Publicadas no período

keywords.title: Keywords / Palavras-chave
keywords.description: Keep tenders whose object contains ANY of these terms (accents and case ignored), e.g. 'notebook', 'merenda escolar', 'software'. Empty = all.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop tenders whose object contains any of these terms.

modalities.title: Modalities / Modalidades
modalities.description: Procurement modalities. Default: electronic reverse auction (pregão eletrônico) and electronic competition (concorrência eletrônica).

states.title: States (UF)
states.description: Two-letter state codes, e.g. SP, MG. Empty = all Brazil.

cityIbgeCodes.title: City IBGE codes
cityIbgeCodes.description: Optional 7-digit IBGE municipality codes, e.g. 3550308 (São Paulo).

agencyCnpjs.title: Agency CNPJs
agencyCnpjs.description: Optional CNPJs of the buying agencies (órgãos).

minValue.title: Min estimated value (BRL)
minValue.description: Keep tenders with estimated value at least this. Tenders without a disclosed value are kept unless 'Drop tenders without value' is on.

maxValue.title: Max estimated value (BRL)
maxValue.description: Keep tenders with estimated value up to this.

dropWithoutValue.title: Drop tenders without value
dropWithoutValue.description: With a min/max value, also drop tenders whose estimated value is confidential or zero.

onlyNew.title: Only new tenders since last run
onlyNew.description: Remember tenders already delivered (in a key-value store of your account) and output only new ones. Use with a daily schedule for alerts.

maxRunSeconds.title: Max run time (seconds)
maxRunSeconds.description: Stop scanning after this many seconds and finish with the tenders found so far. The PNCP API is slow (about 5 s per page), so whole-Brazil searches can take long; raise this for complete scans.
